title: The serving loop
brief: Drive an engine core from a fake model, hold stop strings that span tokens, stream OpenAI chunks, and overlap a slow schedule with the forward pass.
hints: Hold back the longest suffix of the pending text that is a proper prefix of a stop string. Emit it only when the next token shows it is not the stop, and never emit the stop itself.
release decrements a block's refcount. The block returns to the pool only when the count hits zero, so a block another request still holds stays allocated.
The next schedule can run during the current forward. Sampling still waits for logits, so the post stage stays on the clock.
